description: The scrolling area of a chat. Starts at the newest message, follows new messages while the user is at the bottom, and shows a ↓ button when they scroll up.
tip: Give the wrapper a fixed height. Call useMessageScroller() inside MessageScrollerProvider to scroll from code, e.g. scrollToEnd() after sending a message.

parts.provider: Keeps the scroll state. Also place it around components that use the hooks.
parts.item: Wraps one message. Give it a messageId.
parts.button: Round button to the newest (or oldest) message; only shown when needed.
parts.hooks: Hooks: scroll from code, read whether it can scroll, and which messages are visible.

props.autoScroll: Follow new messages while the user is at the bottom.
props.defaultScrollPosition: Starting position: first message, last, or the last anchor.
props.scrollAnchor: When this message arrives, scroll so it sits at the top.
props.direction: Button direction: to the newest or the first message.
props.label: Screen-reader text of the button.
